newsitem.title: USA: Lukens Medical enters global syringe market.
newsitem.headline: Lukens Medical enters global syringe market.

text.p: Lukens Medical Corp said on Wednesday it entered into a joint venture to manufacture hypodermic needles, syringes and related medical products for distribution worldwide.
As part of the transaction, the joint venture acquired a fully-equipped 20,000 square foot plant in the Cochin Export Zone in southern India, Lukens said.
Lukens is a disposable medical products company.

Production was expected to start by early April 1997 and the plant would be capable generating revenues of up to $3.5 million annually in syringes and related products by the end of 1997, Lukens said.
The new subsidiary, Lukens Medical Products Private Ltd is a joint venture between Lukens (USA) and certain of its international distribution partners, the company said.
Lukens would be the majority shareholder and would manage the operations, with all partners contributing to the marketing of the products, it said.

Robert S. Huffstodt, president and chief executive officer of Lukens, said long-term funding totaling almost $2 million for the acquisition was obtained from a combination of bank financing and contributions from the other venture partners.
